::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Largest PDLI project by outlay. Founded June 2024 by Vikram Gakhar, Preetam Tadeparthy and Ram Anant; raised a $16.7M Series A (Peak XV, TDK Ventures). Taped out its first smart power stage in May 2026 (tape-out of the DLI controller IC not confirmed). Acquired by Germany's Infineon (announced August, completed October 2026) — a test of the DLI domestic-status condition after a foreign acquisition.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Software-defined multiphase controllers and smart power stages for server and AI data-centre power delivery.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 3/5:** Multiphase controllers and smart power stages for data-centre power delivery.
- **IP ownership 4/5:** Own software-defined multiphase controller and power-stage designs.
- **Design completeness 3/5:** First smart power stage taped out in May 2026; DLI controller tape-out not confirmed.
- **Market readiness 1/5:** No samples or customers reported; acquired by Infineon in October 2026.
